title: Infinite Horizon Optimal Consumption: Intertemporal Hedging under Epstein-Zin Preferences
summary: We study an infinite-horizon optimal consumption-investment problem for an investor with Epstein-Zin stochastic differential utility in an incomplete market with stochastic investment opportunities. Risk aversion and intertemporal substitution are separated, and we work in the regime $θ\in(0,1)$, where there exists a unique generalised utility process for arbitrary non-negative progressively measurable consumption streams.
